proposals.title: FRESCO CIVITAS
proposals.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: art direction approval sheet for Via Nova, a Roman city-building board game for 2–4 players.
Create a polished landscape concept sheet with a large overhead digital game scene on the left and six enlarged square building tiles on the right, plus a small phone portrait view below the tiles. This is a visual proposal, not a rules diagram.
Game motifs: grid city made from two-square dominos and single-square rebuild tiles; quarries yellow, markets orange, temples blue, barracks red, libraries green, permanent arches purple. All six buildings must be distinct by silhouette. Scroll and banner scoring plaques; population pieces showing Arabic 1 or 2; two Battle contest areas and two Invention contest areas, each with offered rebuild tiles; a market of five dominos. Show a plausible compact city with clear square boundaries and no roads as game spaces. Keep illustrations secondary to legible game geometry. Phone view has a focused city and compact bottom hand of dominos. Public table has no exposed private hands.
Use only the short title VIA NOVA and the proposal subtitle as text, no long rules paragraphs or fake interface microtext. No device photography, watermarks, modern skyscrapers, combat spectacle or copied published art. Keep clear borders and broad quiet scoring plaques.
Text (verbatim): VIA NOVA / FRESCO CIVITAS
Style/medium: Warm original Roman fresco and gouache illustration. Sunlit ivory plaster, chalky mineral pigments, terracotta rooftops, soft hand-painted outlines, restrained stone grain. Tiny human details give civic warmth, not visual clutter. Buildings are shallow isometric illustrations inside strictly top-down square tiles. Flat ivory interface, dark umber legible symbols, rust Battle and sage Invention trays. Rich but calm, tactile tabletop feel.

Style/medium: Original Roman geometric mosaic art. Simplified architectural emblems made of large tesserae, strong dark outlines and jewel mineral colours, ivory grout, restrained midnight stone background, cream inset component panels. Luminous handmade ancient mosaic luxury with modern clarity.
